stories.title: Matthew Boyd / KC Road Trip Recap
stories.angle: Boyd delivered 7 IP, 2 ER to close the Kansas City series. Cubs won the finale and took the series 2-1. Ian Happ went yard for the second straight game. Team had 17 hits. Lead with Boyd's pitching line; kicker on the rotation narrative. No final score per has_score=False insight.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Matthew Boyd. Seven innings. Two earned runs.

The Cubs took the Kansas City series behind Boyd's gem and 17 hits from the lineup — Ian Happ going deep among them.

This rotation isn't slowing down.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: PCA MVP — 7.8 fWAR, Historic Cubs Season
stories.angle: Pete Crow-Armstrong's 7.8 fWAR leads all MLB position players by a wide margin. He's on pace for a second straight 30-30 season. Ohtani hasn't pitched since July 3. Bold take: the NL MVP is in Chicago. No game score.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong has a 7.8 fWAR this season.

That's MLB's best position player mark — by a WIDE margin. He's on pace for a second straight 30-30 season and Shohei Ohtani hasn't pitched since July 3.

The NL MVP is in Chicago.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Rotation Depth — Gausman + Holmes + Boyd + Cabrera Incoming
stories.angle: Gausman, Holmes, and Boyd all started within four days. Counsell's quote: "Pitching is what drives things." Cabrera is targeting mid-August to join the rotation. This is a legitimately dangerous staff for the stretch run.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The Cubs' rotation just had Gausman, Holmes, and Boyd all start within four days.

Gausman: 7 IP sharp in his debut. Holmes: 4 IP in a rocky return. Boyd: seven strong Sunday in KC.

Cabrera's targeting this month to join them.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Nationals Series Preview — Gausman vs Cavalli, Tuesday 4:45 PM CT
stories.angle: 3-game road series at Washington starts Tuesday at 4:45 PM CT. Gausman vs Cade Cavalli (3.57 ERA) in Game 1. The Nationals aren't a contender but Cavalli is a legitimate arm. No easy starts in the stretch run. Kicker: NL's No. 1 Wild Card — act like it.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The Cubs open a 3-game road series at Washington Tuesday, 4:45 PM CT — Gausman vs. Cade Cavalli in Game 1.

The Nationals aren't in the race, but Cavalli carries a 3.57 ERA. No easy starts in the stretch run.

NL's No. 1 Wild Card. Act like it.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Cabrera Return Watch — One Rehab Start Away, Cardinals Homestand Target
stories.angle: Cabrera's Aug 5 Iowa outing: 4 IP, 8 K, 0 BB, 97.4 mph. Counsell says he needs at least 3 rehab starts; two are done. Target return window: Aug 14-19 homestand vs Cardinals + White Sox. Adding Cabrera to an already deep rotation is nearly unfair.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Edward Cabrera needs one more rehab start.

He went 4 IP, 8 K, 0 BB at Iowa on Aug. 5 — touching 97.4 mph. His return target: the Aug. 14 homestand vs. the Cardinals.

Adding a healthy Cabrera to this rotation is just unfair.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Cardinals Sold at Deadline, Now Coming to Wrigley
stories.angle: The Cardinals are in full sell mode — shipped two pitchers to division rival Milwaukee. Hovering around .500. And they're coming to Wrigley in four days. Rivalry humor, witty, never mean-spirited.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
The Cardinals shipped Dustin May and JoJo Romero to Milwaukee at the deadline.

They're hovering around .500 and in full sell mode while the Cubs are chasing a World Series.

And they're coming to Wrigley in four days.

Cardinals fans, save your energy.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Ian Happ — Back-to-Back HRs, Stretch Run Timing
stories.angle: Happ hit HRs in back-to-back games at Kauffman. His 2026 season BA is .212 — a tough year. But the stretch run is when Counsell needs his bat most. Restrained optimism, honest about the season-long numbers.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Ian Happ went yard in back-to-back games at Kauffman Stadium.

He's been fighting a tough season (.212 BA), but the stretch run is exactly when Counsell needs his bat to wake up.

The timing might be perfect.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Prospect Pipeline — Bowser Grand Slam (Knoxville), Wiggins Update (Iowa)
stories.angle: Drew Bowser hit his first Double-A grand slam for the Knoxville Smokies. Jaxon Wiggins (No. 2 Cubs prospect) has elite stuff but command is the work in progress at Iowa. Brief, honest pipeline update.

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text:
Drew Bowser launched his first Double-A grand slam for the Knoxville Smokies last week.

Jaxon Wiggins — the No. 2 Cubs prospect — has elite stuff but is still a work in progress at Iowa.

The pipeline is stacked. The future's close.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs
